response: The expression of c-kit protooncogen in hepatitis B virus-induced chronic hepatitis, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma may have a diagnostic role. Research has shown that c-kit positivity was observed in mitotic, proliferating, and dysplastic hepatic cells, suggesting that c-kit expression could be used as an early diagnostic indicator for HBV-induced hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). This means that detecting c-kit expression could potentially help identify patients at risk of developing HCC, allowing for earlier intervention and treatment.
